# It's Time to Celebrate!

#### Course: API Handling with Asynchronous Javascript

## It's Time to Celebrate!

Congrats on completing our Asynchronous JavaScript course 🥳 🎉

This is a huge milestone for you on your quest to become a junior frontend developer! Now, you finally know:

- The difference between synchronous and asynchronous code
- How callbacks work and why they matter
- How timers, events and the event loop work under the hood
- How to use promises with then / catch
- How to fetch data and handle loading and errors
- How to write cleaner async code with async / await

Furthermore, you also created a mini-project on your own. That's really something — and you should be proud of your achievements!

So why not showcase your accomplishments to the whole wide world? Let people know your worth as a budding frontend developer by:

- Uploading your project on GitHub
- Sharing your project and your certificate on social media like LinkedIn
- Joining our Discord server and engaging with other aspiring developers
